'''Virtual Set 27''' is a Players Committee virtual expansion from the 2014 Reset onward. It was released 9 October 2026.<ref name="setsjson" /><ref name="xpost" /> Six cards were published as a preview on 24 August 2026.<ref name="cardlist" /> These are not Decipher cards.

Current virtual cards are maintained by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee. Printable slips are published with each set.
